## Applied Materials — TTM Net Revenue as of Fiscal Q3 2026 (quarter ended July 26, 2026)

**$30,837 million** (≈ $30.84 billion)

### How it's built from filed figures

Sum of the trailing four fiscal quarters:

| Quarter | Period ended | Net revenue ($M) |
|---|---|---|
| Q4 FY2025 | Oct. 26, 2025 | 6,800 |
| Q1 FY2026 | Jan. 25, 2026 | 7,012 |
| Q2 FY2026 | Apr. 26, 2026 | 7,910 |
| Q3 FY2026 | Jul. 26, 2026 | 9,115 |
| **TTM total** | | **30,837** |

**Cross-check using annual + year-to-date figures** (avoids relying on individually reported quarterly numbers):
- FY2025 full-year net revenue: **28,368**
- Less 9M FY2025 (nine months ended Jul. 27, 2025): **21,568**
- Plus 9M FY2026 (nine months ended Jul. 26, 2026): **24,037**
- = 28,368 − 21,568 + 24,037 = **30,837**

Both approaches reconcile to **$30,837 million**.

### Sourced figures
- Q3 FY2026 (quarterly revenue $9,115M; 9M FY2026 $24,037M; 9M FY2025 $21,568M): [Applied Materials Q3 FY2026 earnings release / 10-Q](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/6951/000162828026058235/amat-20260726.htm) and [IR release](https://ir.appliedmaterials.com/news-releases/news-release-details/applied-materials-announces-third-quarter-2026-results)
- Q4 FY2025 ($6,800M) and FY2025 total ($28,368M): [Q4/FY2025 earnings release](https://ir.appliedmaterials.com/news-releases/news-release-details/applied-materials-announces-fourth-quarter-and-fiscal-year-2025)
- Q1 FY2026 ($7,012M) and Q2 FY2026 ($7,910M): quarterly filings per [Trefis AMAT financials](https://www.trefis.com/data/companies/AMAT) (LTM figure shown as $30,837M, consistent with the above)

Note: the figures above are gross reported net revenue; all values are in USD millions as filed.
